summary: Settings template denies Edit(kernel/**) but installer deploys kernel docs to .azoth/kernel/ — consumer projects lack deny rule for deployed kernel path
evidence: kernel/templates/settings.json.template lines 12-18: deny list includes Edit(kernel/**) but not Edit(.azoth/kernel/**). install.sh deploys kernel docs to .azoth/kernel/. Agents in consumer projects can edit deployed kernel files unchecked.
recommended_action: Add Edit(.azoth/kernel/**) to the deny list in settings.json.template so deployed kernel files in consumer projects are also write-protected

summary: ACTIVATE phase references kernel/ paths but installer deploys to .azoth/kernel/ — boot instructions break in consumer projects
evidence: kernel/BOOTLOADER.md lines 21-30: ACTIVATE step says 'Read kernel/TRUST_CONTRACT.md' and 'Read kernel/GOVERNANCE.md', but install.sh deploys these files under .azoth/kernel/. In an installed project, these paths won't exist.
recommended_action: Update ACTIVATE references to be path-agnostic (e.g., 'read TRUST_CONTRACT.md from the kernel directory') or document both scaffold vs installed paths explicitly

summary: Drift detection example hashes kernel/*.md but installed projects deploy to .azoth/kernel/*.md — documented integrity check will fail
evidence: kernel/GOVERNANCE.md lines 169-177: 'sha256sum kernel/*.md > .azoth/kernel-checksums.sha256' — in installed consumer projects kernel docs live at .azoth/kernel/*.md, so this command will fail or hash nothing.
recommended_action: Update documented command to use deployed path .azoth/kernel/*.md, or document both scaffold and installed paths with clear labels

summary: Kernel integrity check examples hash kernel/BOOTLOADER.md etc but installed layout uses .azoth/kernel/ — documented procedure incorrect for consumer projects
evidence: kernel/TRUST_CONTRACT.md lines 109-117: sha256sum commands reference kernel/BOOTLOADER.md, kernel/TRUST_CONTRACT.md etc. In installed projects these live under .azoth/kernel/.
recommended_action: Update to deployed path .azoth/kernel/ or document both scaffold (kernel/) and installed (.azoth/kernel/) layouts explicitly

summary: read_text() calls lack explicit encoding — will raise UnicodeDecodeError on Windows where default encoding is not UTF-8
evidence: tests/test_skills.py lines 132-155: Four read_text() calls without encoding parameter. SKILL.md files contain non-ASCII characters (arrows like →). On Windows the default encoding is often cp1252, not UTF-8.
recommended_action: Change all read_text() calls to read_text(encoding='utf-8') for cross-platform test portability

summary: Session closeout references architecture decisions D1-D28 but repo now tracks D1-D41 — evaluation criteria is stale
evidence: .claude/commands/session-closeout.md line 20: 'Architecture decisions (D1-D28) respected' — docs/DECISIONS_INDEX.md tracks D1-D41 and tests validate 41 decisions.
recommended_action: Update to D1-D41 or reference docs/DECISIONS_INDEX.md dynamically instead of hardcoding a decision count

summary: Eval command hardcodes D1-D28 but architecture decisions now span D1-D41 — eval guidance is stale
evidence: .claude/commands/eval.md line 11: 'Architecture alignment — decisions respect D1-D28' — decisions index and tests confirm 41 decisions exist.
recommended_action: Update to D1-D41 or reference docs/DECISIONS_INDEX.md instead of hardcoding decision range

summary: Bootloader state schema shows active_phase: 1 (integer) but template uses active_phase: operate (string) — type mismatch between docs and runtime
evidence: kernel/BOOTLOADER.md line 143: 'active_phase: 1' (integer). kernel/templates/bootloader-state.md.template uses 'active_phase: operate' (string enum from ACTIVATE/SURVEY/OPERATE/HARDEN). Boot phases are named, not numbered.
recommended_action: Align BOOTLOADER.md schema to use string enum matching template: active_phase: activate (or operate, etc.) instead of integer 1

summary: AZOTH_PHASE is 1.5-complete but azoth.yaml manifest and tests indicate current phase is 3 — phase mismatch may confuse agents
evidence: .claude/settings.json line 23: AZOTH_PHASE: '1.5-complete'. azoth.yaml phase: 3. Tests validate phase 3. settings.json.template uses 'operate'. Three different values across three sources.
recommended_action: Update .claude/settings.json AZOTH_PHASE to match current phase (3 or 'phase-3') and establish a single encoding convention across azoth.yaml, settings.json, and template

summary: Recurring pattern: kernel docs reference scaffold paths (kernel/) but consumer projects use deployed paths (.azoth/kernel/) — systemic path duality not documented
evidence: Three separate review comments flagged the same root cause: BOOTLOADER.md ACTIVATE references, GOVERNANCE.md drift detection, and TRUST_CONTRACT.md integrity checks all use kernel/ paths that don't exist in installed projects. This is a systemic issue, not isolated bugs.
recommended_action: Establish a D42 decision documenting the path duality convention: scaffold uses kernel/, consumer uses .azoth/kernel/. Add a Path Convention section to BOOTLOADER.md explaining both contexts. Update all kernel docs with dual-path awareness.
